definition: a person who gives money to a good cause
description: On a street of brick terraced houses in autumn, two movers in dark workwear stand by a shiny black grand piano on a metal ramp from a white van, outside a small community library with a blue door. A young man in a navy jumper hands a key to a smiling red-haired young woman, and the two talk while neighbours on the pavement clap. One mover pulls the padded blanket off the piano. Fallen leaves and lifting straps lie on the ground.

en.question: What is the red-haired woman doing?

de.answer: Sie nimmt einen Schlüssel von ihm entgegen.
de.question: Was macht die rothaarige Frau?

es.answer: Está aceptando la llave que él le da.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer pelirroja?

fr.answer: Elle accepte une clé qu'il lui tend.
fr.question: Que fait la femme rousse ?
